item.title: Hanroro releases new single 'Question Mark'
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
Singer-songwriter Hanroro released her new single "Question Mark" on Thursday. The song deals with conflicting emotions in personal relationships, including affection, resentment and regret, continuing Hanroro's exploration of the difficulties and uncertainties of young adulthood. Ahead of the release, Hanroro shared a synopsis on social media last month, outlining a story involving two childhood friends who meet at a swimming school and grow up sharing their dreams. item.title: Seventeen’s Dino drops surprise single
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
Seventeen's Dino will drop a solo digital single on Tuesday, a surprise hello from the enlisted musician, his agency Pledis Entertainment said. He wrote both the lyrics and melody of “Automatic,” which conveys the fluttering feelings of falling in love.
